editorial:
Imagine being the smartest guy in school but totally invisible to the girl of your dreams. That is exactly where you find Cyrus, a tech-savvy hacker at Bergerac High who is head-over-heels for his best friend, Roxy. In a twist of bad luck, the school's most popular athlete asks Cyrus for help winning Roxy over. Instead of saying no, Cyrus uses his social media skills to play matchmaker, basically coaching his rival on how to be the perfect guy. It is a sweet, awkward, and funny setup that feels like a classic high school crush story with a modern digital spin.

You will really enjoy how the movie balances the comedy with those cringy, relatable moments of unrequited love. The pacing is quick, and the chemistry between the leads makes the drama feel real. While some of the plot points are a bit predictable, the heart of the story keeps you rooting for the underdog. If you want a cozy night in, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture quality, or just rent it on Apple TV if you are in a rush. It is the perfect pick for a lazy weekend.
endingExplained: After spending the whole movie helping the athlete, Cyrus finally finds the courage to be honest about his feelings. Roxy realizes that the athlete was only acting the way he did because of Cyrus's hacking and advice. She chooses the real, authentic version of Cyrus over the fake version of the star player. The movie wraps up with Cyrus and Roxy finally getting together, proving that being yourself is better than any social media trick.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cheesy high school romances and underdog stories.
